subject: Renewal conversion to 24m, phased uplift and billing cutover coordination
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightline.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Procurement Ops <procurement@brightline.health>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversion: proposal to move to 24m + phased uplift

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the renewal proposal last week. The execs are comfortable moving forward with a multi‑year conversation but have two asks before we can begin procurement:

1) Can we split the 24‑month term into a staged uplift so our platform team can validate traffic increases without hitting SLOs? Prefer 4 quarterly ramp checkpoints.
2) We need clarity on the billing cutover: our fiscal year closes Jan 31 and we require a mid‑term invoice/cutover plan so our finance team can reconcile.

Also, please confirm that Redwood will include the SOC2 evidence we requested in the procurement packet.

If we can get a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and an operational checklist for the cutover, we can loop procurement and legal.

Best,
Elena
Senior Procurement Manager
Brightline Health

--
Attachment: requirements_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightline.health>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversion: proposal to move to 24m + phased uplift

Elena —

Thanks for the clear asks. Happy to align. High‑level proposal below; I will send a formal MAP and cutover checklist by Monday.

- Term: 24 months, co‑term with existing contract end date (we'll show the exact co‑term dates in the MAP)
- Phased uplift: 4 checkpoints (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) with optional canary window. Each checkpoint triggers either a capacity increase (GPU pool add) or autoscale policy update.
- Fiscal billing cutover: we can split the change into two invoices — a pro‑rated transition invoice to align usage, then standard monthly/quarterly invoicing after cutover. Kimberly (cc) will propose invoice cadence and any proration examples.
- SOC2 evidence: attaching our latest SOC2 attestation and a link to the security packet.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will produce a 1‑page MAP with milestones and owners by Mon 11/23.
2) Camila will draft the onboarding ops checklist and the staged ramp playbook.
3) Kimberly will send a sample cutover invoice and proration spreadsheet.

Can you confirm procurement/legal will need an executed SOW or a signed Master Subscription Agreement first? That will affect sequencing.

I'll attach the draft SOW and the cutover checklist draft in a follow up.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments referenced: Brightline_SOW_v1.pdf, SOC2_Attestation.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversion: proposal to move to 24m + phased uplift

Looping in operational details so we can be precise in the MAP. Key ops notes below: 

- Canary plan: for each checkpoint we recommend a 7‑day canary traffic ramp (start at 10% qps for 48h, 40% next 48h, then 100% final 72h) with rollback thresholds tied to latency 95th percentile and error rate.
- Capacity model: we will provision a dedicated GPU pool per checkpoint with burst headroom of 20% for the first 30 days. If Brightline prefers single dedicated pool w/auto‑scale, we can propose that variant.
- KV cache warmup: ops will prewarm cache for common prefixes 24h before each checkpoint to avoid latency spikes.
- Monitoring: we will provide dashboard links and an alert playbook; please add the OK‑to‑execute signoff owner for each checkpoint in the MAP (we typically ask for a Brightline SRE and Brightline Product manager).

I attached a short cutover checklist draft and the ramp playbook. Jordan — I'm happy to host a 30‑min ops walk with Elena + procurement/legal to walk the checklist.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Billing_Cutover_Checklist.xlsx (workbook stub); Ramp_Playbook.pdf (doc stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightline.health>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversion: proposal to move to 24m + phased uplift — billing cadence options

Hi Elena / team —

Per Jordan's ask on billing cutover, attaching an example proration and two invoice cadence options:

Option A (preferred): Transition invoice dated Jan 15, 2027 to cover pro‑rated capacity changes through Jan 31, then monthly invoices from Feb 1. This minimizes accounting fragmentation.
Option B: Create a single mid‑term invoice at cutover (Feb 1) and backdate usage to align with fiscal period. This has more manual reconciliation.

Numbers: I populated the attached Billing_Cutover_Checklist.xlsx with illustrative proration for the first checkpoint (assumes 20% burst capacity added Nov 1). Please review and tell us which option aligns with your AP process.

Also noting: for any multi‑year discounts we need a firm start date for when the discounted pricing applies (we recommend discount starts at first checkpoint activation).

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Billing_Cutover_Checklist.xlsx (contains proration examples)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightline.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Procurement Ops <procurement@brightline.health>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversion: proposal to move to 24m + phased uplift — billing cadence options

Jordan / Kimberly —

Thanks — Option A works best for our AP cadence. Procurement and legal are aligned on sequencing: we need an executed SOW and an MSA amendment that specifies the 24m term and the checkpoint cadence before AP issues the transition invoice.

Procurement will sign once we receive the MAP + redline‑ready SOW. We will also accept SOC2 attestation as documented in your packet.

Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Brightline Health
